data.summary: Sheetal Deshpande, an existing client (2BHK, Viman Nagar, designer Aryan), called at 10:40 pm upset about no reply for five days. The transfer to the team did not connect. The agent apologised, took her details and promised a call back from a senior person; she prefers tomorrow before 11 am.

entities.notes_for_designer: Existing project complaint: designer Aryan has not replied in five days. Wants a call back from Nikhil or a senior person.

data.transcript:
[22:40:11] AGENT: Namaste, thank you for calling Aangan Studio. I'm Aangan's AI assistant, and this call is recorded so our designers have your details. How can I help you today?

[22:40:19] USER: I need to speak to someone right now. My project has been going for three months and my designer hasn't replied in five days.

[22:40:28] AGENT: I'm very sorry about that. May I have your name so I can connect you to the team right away?

[22:40:33] USER: Sheetal Deshpande. My designer is Aryan. Flat in Viman Nagar, 2BHK.

[22:40:41] AGENT: Thank you, Sheetal. I'm connecting you to our team now. Please stay on the line.

[22:41:35] AGENT: I'm sorry, Sheetal, I wasn't able to reach the team just now. I'm noting your name, your Viman Nagar project and your designer's name. When is the best time for a senior person to call you back?

[22:41:50] USER: Tomorrow morning, before 11. And I want it from Nikhil or someone senior.

[22:41:57] AGENT: I've noted that. A senior person will call you back tomorrow morning before 11 am. I'm sorry again for the trouble.

[22:42:05] USER: Okay.

[22:42:08] AGENT: Thank you, Sheetal. A senior person from Aangan will call you tomorrow before 11 am.
